title: Expose a bounded local proof API with rate limits
description: Wrap existing actual AnonCreds proof and replay store in a local JSON API. Enforce strict input, origin/host checks, size limits, workload bounds and safe error responses.
acceptance_criteria: Test valid verification, tampering, replay, cross-session access, consent bypass and rate limits; retain macOS and Windows/Ubuntu CI evidence. No production HTTP claim.

title: Add wallet request review and explicit consent
description: Build a Japanese synthetic-wallet screen showing verifier, purpose, exact predicates, expiry and disclosure. Bind approval or denial to the stored immutable request.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated user can approve and verify a real synthetic proof or deny; no proof generation or verification without approval; verify the visible browser flow.
close_reason: Implemented local synthetic sessions and explicit request-bound consent. Real-crypto HTTP boundary tests and browser approve/deny flow passed on macOS. See service.py, web/, tests/test_service.py and docs/service.md. Real-user enrollment and holder isolation remain separate open tasks.

title: Add synthetic-account session authentication
description: Implement loopback-only prototype login, session expiry, logout, request ownership and CSRF checks. A random startup code authenticates access to one synthetic account; it does not establish real identity.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP tests verify missing, expired and cross-session access is refused; document prototype boundaries.
close_reason: Implemented local synthetic sessions and explicit request-bound consent. Real-crypto HTTP boundary tests and browser approve/deny flow passed on macOS. See service.py, web/, tests/test_service.py and docs/service.md. Real-user enrollment and holder isolation remain separate open tasks.

title: Establish an authoritative driving-entitlement status source
description: Investigate access to suspension, cancellation and expiry status, eligibility, contracts, freshness and outage behavior. Distinguish on-card expiry and JPKI certificate revocation from current driving entitlement.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm an authoritative usable interface and access conditions, or record the unresolved source and prohibit claims of live status verification.
notes: Initial NPA/JSDC/JPKI source review recorded in docs/real-license-integration.md. No usable current driving-status API/access conditions confirmed. Historical certificates and JPKI certificate status are not live driving-entitlement checks. Provider follow-up is still required.

title: Establish a trusted licence public-key source
description: Determine how issuer public keys or certificates can be obtained, licensed, authenticated and refreshed for traditional IC and My Number licences. Public signature formats alone are insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Record a documented distribution source, usage conditions, trust anchors and update policy, or keep the integration gate explicitly unresolved.
notes: NPA smartphone manual page 11 confirms official app certificate updates. Reuse/distribution terms and trusted key acquisition for a custom service remain unconfirmed. See docs/real-license-integration.md; no provider contacted.

title: Research access conditions for real licence reading
description: Check current NPA specifications, official app terms, PIN requirements, SDK licensing and supported card variants. Record primary links and unresolved conditions. No real cards or external provider contact in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Save dated findings distinguishing published specifications from permission to reuse software or access services; identify required follow-up evidence.
close_reason: Completed initial public-source research in docs/real-license-integration.md on 2026-10-15. No real-card execution, provider contact or contractual eligibility claimed. Key and status access remain open separately.

title: Validate the demo on Windows with the real backend
description: Extend the existing Python 3.12 CI to Windows. Run hash-pinned AnonCreds, the full test suite, proof generation, independent CLI verification and replay rejection. Preserve logs and exact environment details. Scope is the synthetic CLI demo only.
acceptance_criteria: A Windows runner completes all real-crypto tests without skips and the demo gates; record commit, run URL, versions and retained evidence. Configuration alone does not close the task.
close_reason: Windows Server 2022 x64 / Python 3.12.10 / AnonCreds 0.2.3 passed all 50 tests (16 real-crypto, no skips), standalone proof generation, independent verification and already_used replay rejection at 78ba7d16f353cb7518edd74f71ce3f864512e699. CI: https://github.com/ToppyMicroServices/zk-license-demo/actions/runs/38671009097 . Evidence: docs/evidence/2026-10-15/ and docs/performance.md. Windows desktop, ARM and PowerShell setup remain outside the tested environment.

title: Measure repeated synthetic proof performance
description: Replace the single illustrative timing with a reproducible bounded benchmark. Separate issuer setup from repeated proof generation and SQLite-backed verification, exclude labeled warmups, retain raw measurements and source hashes, and check acceptance and replay rejection for every iteration. Report median and p95 without production throughput claims.
acceptance_criteria: Run at least 30 measured iterations after warmup; retain a machine-readable result with environment, raw samples, median, p95, proof size, source hashes and explicit scope. Verify summary calculations and fail closed on proof or replay errors.
close_reason: Completed 3 warmups plus 30 serial measured iterations on macOS, Ubuntu and Windows with real AnonCreds. Retained raw data, median/p95, setup/issuance timing, versions and source hashes in docs/evidence/2026-10-15/. Independently recomputed summaries and verified every acceptance/replay result and source hash (exit 0). Timing limits and observed Windows tail latency are recorded in docs/performance.md; no service throughput claim.

title: Prepare production API and operational readiness
description: Select a production server and storage architecture; add TLS, distributed limits, observability, backups, incident recovery and deployment checks after integration conditions are clear.
acceptance_criteria: Record tested availability and load targets, recovery evidence, provider failures, data retention and reviewed deployment configuration; do not treat local demo tests as production approval.

title: Implement issuer key rotation, revocation and recovery
description: Define key versions, trust updates, revocation support and compromised-key recovery. Current synthetic AnonCreds definitions have revocation disabled and restart with new keys.
acceptance_criteria: Test overlap, rollback, emergency distrust, credential renewal and restoration without silently accepting compromised credentials.

title: Integrate verified real-user identity and passkeys
description: Choose identity enrollment through an eligible JPKI provider or other documented route, then bind passkey login and credential holder to that enrollment. Passkey possession alone is not identity proof.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm provider access, recovery and account-binding model; test enrollment, reauthentication and account recovery using approved test environments.

title: Separate the holder wallet from the verifier service
description: The local prototype co-locates issuer, holder and verifier. Design and implement actual client custody, authenticated verifier requests and holder binding before making wallet privacy claims.
acceptance_criteria: Keep holder credential and link secret outside the verifier; test request integrity, consent binding and account/device changes.

title: Implement a real licence ingestion and signature adapter
description: After reading and key conditions are established, implement real-card reading and verification with authorized test materials. Keep issuer ingestion distinct from ZK verification.
acceptance_criteria: Verify signatures and failures against authorized specimens; document signed-field coverage and changes not covered by the original signature.

title: Finalize and publish the LinkedIn demo post
description: docs/linkedin-ja.md already contains a draft. The 2026-10-04 record says unposted; current external posting status is unverified. Confirm status and the exact approved text and destination before sending. Keep synthetic-credential and scope limits.
acceptance_criteria: Avoid duplicate publication; obtain approval of exact text and destination before posting, then record the public URL and date. Draft preparation alone is not publication.

title: Evaluate responses to the public demo
description: Implement the evaluation proposed in docs/publication-decision.md using concrete technical questions, README visits where available and reproducibility reports. Use aggregate evidence; do not equate impressions or visits with brand improvement.
acceptance_criteria: Record observation window, available data sources, aggregate observations and limitations. Distinguish unavailable metrics from zero results.

title: Arrange an optional independent review of the demo
description: No independent security audit is established in docs/validation.md. Define a review scope limited to the synthetic demo, then record an independent reviewer result if commissioned. Existing tests are regression evidence, not an audit. No production identity integration is included.
acceptance_criteria: Record reviewer independence, reviewed revision, scope, findings and limits, or an explicit decision to defer. Do not label an internal self-review as an independent audit.
